name: Pao's rifle
description: Pao's rifle was an illegal black market boiler rifle purchased by the Drabatan rebel Paodok'Draba'Takat. The weapon was modified with an external tibanna gas chamber to amp up the its destructive output. The modification burned through galven barrels quickly, requiring constant upkeep. Pao utilized this blaster during the Battle of Scarif in 1 BBY, where he perished.
